name: Unnamed Project

entity_types.name: TalkingAnimal
entity_types.description: A non-human biological entity capable of human-like speech and social interaction.

attributes.name: species
attributes.description: The biological species of the animal

attributes.name: cognitive_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of the animal's reasoning and intelligence level

attributes.name: vocal_type
attributes.description: Description of the animal's speech patterns and vocal range

entity_types.name: Scientist
entity_types.description: Researchers and academics specializing in biology, cognition, or linguistics.

attributes.name: expertise_area
attributes.description: Specific field such as Evolutionary Biology or Cognitive Science

attributes.name: academic_rank
attributes.description: Professional title like Professor, Lead Researcher, or Fellow

attributes.name: lab_affiliation
attributes.description: The university or research institute they belong to

entity_types.name: GovernmentAgency
entity_types.description: State bodies managing regulation, national security, and legal categorization.

attributes.name: agency_name
attributes.description: Official name of the administrative body

attributes.name: regulatory_scope
attributes.description: The specific domain of control, e.g., Wildlife, Immigration, Security

attributes.name: legal_authority
attributes.description: The level of power to detain or grant rights

entity_types.name: Corporation
entity_types.description: Commercial entities seeking to monetize, sponsor, or patent the discovery.

attributes.name: company_name
attributes.description: The legal name of the business entity

attributes.name: industry_type
attributes.description: Sector such as Biotechnology, Entertainment, or Mass Media

attributes.name: commercial_interest
attributes.description: The primary goal, e.g., genetic patents, media rights

entity_types.name: MediaOutlet
entity_types.description: Traditional news organizations shaping the national and global narrative.

attributes.name: outlet_name
attributes.description: Name of the news organization

attributes.name: editorial_lean
attributes.description: The political or philosophical bias of the reporting

attributes.name: audience_demographic
attributes.description: The primary group of people consuming this media

entity_types.name: Influencer
entity_types.description: Social media personalities driving viral trends and public awareness.

attributes.name: social_handle
attributes.description: The username or public persona name

attributes.name: platform_base
attributes.description: Primary platform like TikTok, X, or YouTube

attributes.name: follower_count
attributes.description: Scale of the influencer's reach

entity_types.name: Person
entity_types.description: Any individual person not fitting other specific person types.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: Full name of the person

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Role or occupation

entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: Any organization not fitting other specific organization types.

attributes.name: org_name
attributes.description: Name of the organization

attributes.name: org_type
attributes.description: Type of organization

simulation_requirement: Predict what happens to the world if a talking animal is discovered.
